messages:
Priya: quick sync — heads up I sketched a simple 'bottleneck map' for console observability. want to confirm owners + any hidden deps before i push to the roadmap doc. TL;DR: dashboards + trace hooks + error-analysis views + retention gating.

Tom: can you drop the link? i can call out platform infra deps once i see the map.

Priya: sure — https://docs.internal/redwood/console-obsv/bottleneck-map-draft (draft only)

Asha: skimmed. note: runtime needs KV-ttl change for trace prefix caching — that affects retention gating for traces. flagged in the map under 'runtime'.

Riley: alerting note — some of the error-analysis views rely on the new sample-rate header (feature flag: sampling-v2). if teams don't enable it'll undercount errors. cc @Marta for the visibility story.

Marta: thanks, adding a visibility checkbox to the map. also can we set a hard deadline for the retention config PR? brings clarity for the Legal review.

Priya: proposing milestones: (1) owners + deps confirmed by EOD Tue, (2) retention PR open Wed, (3) canary tracing hooks by next Mon. ok?

Tom: EOD Tue +1. runtime will try to get a compatibility note in that PR.

Asha: Wed PR is tight but doable. i'll create a short changelog entry and a sample config snippet:
```yaml
tracing:
  retention_days: 30
  prefix_cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
  sampling_header: sampling-v2
```

Riley: can we also add a small playbook for oncall if retention misconfig causes spike? short steps: revert config, toggle sampling-v2 off, escalate to infra. i'll draft.

Priya: perfect. Marta — legal needs a heads-up when PR is open, ok to ping them Wed morning?

Marta: yes, i'll ping Legal once the PR link is posted.

deploy-bot: canary deployment for obs-tracing-hooks started (canary-42) — monitor at https://ci.internal/canary-42 

Tom: noted. i'll keep an eye on token bucket metrics and the batcher latency.

Priya: action items recap:
- Priya: finalize map + request owners in doc (today)
- Tom: infra compatibility note + monitor canary (this week)
- Asha: open retention PR + changelog (Wed)
- Riley: draft oncall playbook for retention failures (Fri)
- Marta: legal ping when PR visible

Priya: thanks all. dropping a reminder card in the roadmap board for the milestones. will follow up async if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
